messages:
Sam Ortega: hey team, Sam here — first day! quick qs: 1) I got a phish-sim notice but my MacBook is delayed in shipping. Do I need to enroll my personal Mac? 2) how do I check/enforce FileVault? 3) will I be blocked from #eng-dedicated until training is done?

Maya (People Ops): welcome Sam! :wave: You don’t have to enroll a personal device. Request a loaner via the facilities form and we mark you as exempt from the sim until you have a managed device. Security Basics + Data Handling are required for full channel access within 72h.

Felix IT: @Sam - quick check for FileVault: open Terminal and run `fdesetup status`. If it returns "Off", enable via System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault > Turn On or run `sudo fdesetup enable -user <shortname>`. If you want, we can push a temporary minimal MDM policy but we prefer loaner for personal devices.

Sam Ortega: fdesetup says "FileVault is Off" — Ill enable tonight. Can I request a loaner?

Facilities: Loaner request received for Sam Ortega. Please fill the loaner form (https://redwood.intranet/facilities/loaner-form) and choose delivery or pickup. We can include charger + privacy screen. ETA 2 business days after approval.

Nora InfoSec: MFA is independent of device — set up Authenticator and at least one backup method when you get the identity invite. For the phishing sim: if you have a loaner youll be included; otherwise we defer you. Also please finish Security Basics before the sim window.

PhishSimBot: User Sam Ortega tentatively scheduled for simulated phishing cohort on 2026-05-12. Reply "loaner-request" here to request exemption until a managed device is assigned.

Sam Ortega: loaner-request. enabled FileVault and filled the loaner form. thanks for the speedy help!

Maya (People Ops): marked Sam as exempt and added to the onboarding tracker. Welcome aboard! :tada:
